The '''1963 [[Eliteserien|1. divisjon]]''' was the 19th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. This was the first regular season when all the top flight teams played in the same group.

==Overview==
It was contested by 10 teams, and [[SK Brann|Brann]] won their second consecutive championship title.

[[FK Lyn|Lyn]] lead the table after 9 games, and qualified for the [[1963–64 European Cup]]. 

[[Steinkjer FK|Steinkjer]] and [[SK Gjøvik-Lyn|Gjøvik-Lyn]] finished 9th and 10th and were relegated to the [[1. divisjon|2. divisjon]].
